en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a multi‑storey institutional building with a steep tiled roof, decorative elements and large windows. In front is a wrought‑iron fence with brick pillars and a gate. Several people, likely students or staff, walk along the cobbled street. On the facade appears the name of the institute, and at the bottom margin of the postcard is printed text identifying the location as the Pasteur Hygiene Institute in Cluj.
